premises.text: Local clinics are not equipped to meet patients' needs with existing tools.
premises.evidence_span: clinics are not equipped to meet patients' needs.

premises.text: Existing medical imaging tools are expensive or too bulky for local clinics.
premises.evidence_span: Many tools available in large hospitals are not accessible because they are expensive or too bulky.

premises.text: An ultrasound solution on an iPad can improve diagnosis in local clinics.
premises.evidence_span: We have built an ultrasound solution working on an iPad.

premises.text: Practitioners can use the tool to diagnose patients remotely and connect with specialists.
premises.evidence_span: local clinics can better diagnose and connect to specialists to improve the patient's health.

premises.text: The device is significantly cheaper than traditional ultrasound devices.
premises.evidence_span: At 14,900 euros, Auscult is a great tool for emergency. This is one third of the price of the regular ultrasound device.

premises.text: The portable ultrasound market is growing rapidly.
premises.evidence_span: this sector of portable devices have a 16% annual growth rate.

premises.text: The device is in trials with local clinics in emergent market countries.
premises.evidence_span: we are in trials with local clinics in emergent market countries, including Mozambique, Rwanda, Cameroon, and Mauritius.

premises.text: Regulatory approvals are on track for the device to be sold in the US and European markets.
premises.evidence_span: CE, medical, and FDA are on track to be approved by mid-next year, which will allow us to sell to US and European markets.

value.text: Healthcare providers can improve patient diagnosis and care with accessible ultrasound technology.
value.evidence_span: local clinics can better diagnose and connect to specialists to improve the patient's health.
